name: lot_developer_persistence
description: Test 17 (§13, §16). The save record is written in order: version 1 (uint16), vertsX (sint32), extentX (float32), extentZ (float32), n = the night deque size (uint32), each building front to back as an object reference, the cursor index (uint32), nightMode (uint8, low byte), litFlag (uint8 0/1). A 64x64-cell city with cell width 16 and a 64x64 terrain gives vertsX = 65 (0x41), extentX = extentZ = 1024.0 (0x44800000); with an empty deque, mode 0 and unlit, the record is the 24 bytes '01 00 | 41 00 00 00 | 00 00 80 44 | 00 00 80 44 | 00 00 00 00 | 00 00 00 00 | 00 | 00'. A version-2 record is rejected after 2 bytes (nothing more is read). A round trip restores the deque, the cursor, the mode and the lit flag, and Read sets nightAcc to 0. Object references are encoded object-id then class-id (foundations §2.7); the class here is cISC4BuildingOccupant 0x87DDA3A9 (little-endian a9a3dd87).

steps.note: 24 bytes: version 1, vertsX 65, extentX 1024.0, extentZ 1024.0, n 0, cursor 0, mode 0, unlit
a version-2 record is rejected after 2 bytes
nothing was overwritten (the version check comes first)
two buildings as host references (object ids 1 and 2, class 0x87DDA3A9), cursor 1, mode 2, lit 1
the same record read into a fresh instance
both buildings resolved from their references
writing it again gives the same bytes
version 1 but truncated before the extents: Read returns false, having already overwritten vertsX with 0xffffffff (fields 2-4 are stored as they are read)
